Synopsis:
Two duergar consider how their fellow duergar have fallen for this new cult that showed up. You can inspire in them a mutiny. If you do, they'll join you when you free Nere (UND_TheDrowNere_Mutiny).Brithvar is a Mind Master, a duergar with psionic skills. He wears a strange mask.

Cluster Contexts:
- UND_DuergarCamp_Mutineers.json: This scene takes place in a tense duergar camp where Elder Brithvar (a masked Mind Master with psionic sensitivity) and a stone guard, Kur, are muttering about how the new True Soul cult has won over some of their kin. Off‑screen Sergeant Thrinn has slaves and gnomes digging to free Nere, a True Soul said to hold wealth, and Brithvar spots a small barrel that might be used as an explosive to disrupt the drow. Duergar distrust True Souls (they claim they can “smell” the tadpole/psionic taint) and initially threaten any suspected cultist, but Brithvar offers a different plan: help free Nere, then the duergar will seize and split his riches. If the player convinces them to mutiny, Brithvar and his comrades will ally with the party when Nere is freed.
- UND_TheDrowNere_FollowUp.json: After fighting and killing a group of duergar servants that mutinied against him, Nere takes his rage and frustration out on one of their bodies by kicking it. Once he's done, he takes the players to a nearby broken bridge and explains that he needs reinforcements. The player can promise they'll inform his boss - Chosen Ketheric - or not.
- UND_DuergarLoyalSergeant.json: The scene takes place in a duergar camp where Sergeant Thrinn has been left in charge after a tunnel collapse that trapped a gnome named Nere; Thrinn is furious, ordering the enslaved gnomes pushed and even suggesting cruel measures (heating rocks, etc.). She realizes—or is shown—that the player is a True Soul after a brief mind‑meld that only stirs the parasite (an echoing, tickling memory), and as a result asks the player to help free Nere; the player may accept or refuse and can also hand over any missing boots for a reward. The player can likewise question Thrinn about a gnome who escaped and about a scrying eye the duergar use. Companions (Shadowheart appears in the samples) or recent tense beats—combat, psychic visions, or nearby fugitives like Karlach—may be present off‑screen and help explain the party’s terse, on‑edge tone.
- UND_TheDrowNere_Mutiny.json: Dialogue after you destroy the cave-in and set Nere free. Thrinn has been put in charge of getting Nere out, but it's the player who accomplishes it. Nere almost just died from inhaling poisonous gas, so he's very angry. In this dialogue, you determine the fate of the gnomes as well as Nere and the mutinous duergar.
- UND_DuergarRebelGreedy_AD_CaveInDestroyed.json: Elder Brithvar comments when cave-in is destroyed. Remarks on how it's time he killed Nere if player took mutiny quest.

After fighting and killing a group of duergar servants that mutinied against him, Nere takes his rage and frustration out on one of their bodies by kicking it. Once he's done, he takes the players to a nearby broken bridge and explains that he needs reinforcements. The player can promise they'll inform his boss - Chosen Ketheric - or not.

context: You overhear Elder Brithvar — a masked duergar Mind Master with psionic sensitivity — and a stone guard, Kur, muttering in a tense duergar camp while Sergeant Thrinn (off‑screen) has slaves and gnomes digging to free a trapped gnome named Nere, a captured True Soul said to hold wealth. Duergar distrust True Souls and claim they can “smell” the psionic/tadpole taint, so Brithvar immediately assumes the player is one and reacts with suspicion. Brithvar spots a small barrel that might be used as an explosive against the drow and offers a different plan from Thrinn’s glory‑seeking orders: help free Nere, then the mutineers will seize and split his riches, promising the player a cut. If the player convinces them to mutiny, Brithvar and his companions will join the party once Nere is freed.
